errors.evidence: The bar does not correspond to the point 0.0; it represents the bin or range from 0.0 to 0.2 on the x-axis. This error pattern is repeated for all the bars described.
The height of the first bar represents 11.2%, which corresponds to a value of 0.112 on the y-axis, not 0.011.
The vertical dashed red line is positioned at 0.82 on the horizontal axis, as indicated by the text "mean: 0.82".
